title: Cohomological boundedness for the canonical Brown right adjoint
statement: Fix the standing ell-adic coefficient, schemes, and proper morphism of lem-sfb-adic-localizing-exceptional-bounded. If the proper localizing pushforward F = ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar has its canonical Brown right adjoint supplied by an IsLeftAdjoint witness, then for every bounded constructible K the underlying object of the canonical right adjoint F.rightAdjoint(K) has homology vanishing outside a finite integer interval.

proof.text: Finite-type schemes over the field are Noetherian and qcqs. Embed an arbitrary finite coefficient field into the fixed algebraic closure and use its equivalence with its image; finite-dimensional linear equivalences are continuous in both directions. Restrict the induced isometry to the integer rings. Construct the resulting condensed-ring isomorphisms sectionwise with explicitly inverse maps. The algebraic-closure coefficient remains the finite-subextension-valued ring.

proof.text: For continuous finite coefficients normalize to a finite intermediate subfield and use its existing local-free-cover theorem on every Noetherian stratum. Convert local free modules into finite constant scalar models using pullback of finite free modules and cokernels of zero maps. Conversely use their finite presentations. Transport the resulting constructibility equivalence to the original coefficient ring. The presentation and stratification transport helpers from CondensedConstructibleSerre are proved declarations; its global Serre theorem is not assumed.

proof.text: For integral coefficients, uniqueness of the extended absolute value identifies the embedded integer ring with the spectral integer ring on ULift E. Construct the ring equivalence, homeomorphism, and sectionwise condensed-ring isomorphism explicitly. Transport both constructibility predicates along this isomorphism and apply integralLfpConstantModelComparison. For the finite-subextension algebraic closure use its own local-free theorem and the same stratification argument.

proof.text: Use localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc to identify the finite-Tor constant-model generators with the general bounded constructible generators. Prove equality of the two localizing intersections: localizing closure is replete and triangulated by its defining universal property, while a coproduct has only a small set of nonzero summands, since their pairwise orthogonal projection idempotents inject into its endomorphisms. Restrict to that small support to compare the coproduct indexing universes. All five closure and universe-comparison helpers are proved privately in this module.

proof.text: Apply exceptionalInverseImage_exists to these admissible coefficients. For the proper compactification (id,g), identify derived extension by zero along the identity with the identity using uniqueness of left adjoints and upperStarId. Its compactification comparison identifies the left functor with Rg_*. Restrict the supplied canonical adjunction through the fully faithful equal-hull inclusions, then use rightAdjointUniq to transport preservation of finite-Tor constant-model constructibles to the canonical right adjoint.
